module.purpose: Provides the application layout wrapper for booking-page routes, supplying request-specific security metadata and booking-specific configuration to the shared page wrapper.
module.summary: This asynchronous route layout reads the incoming request's nonce header, converts a missing value to undefined, and renders the shared application page wrapper around child route content. It marks the route as a booking page, disables license requirements, and preserves the request nonce for downstream rendering.
module.businessContext: Supports booking workflows by applying consistent page-level behavior and security metadata. Failure can break booking-page rendering or prevent nonce-dependent security policies from being applied.
functions: BookingPageWrapperLayout (~L5-16): Reads the request nonce and wraps booking route content.

io: Reads the incoming request headers through Next.js headers().

sectionMap.name: request metadata acquisition
sectionMap.intent: Await request headers and extract the optional nonce value.

sectionMap.intent: Render child content inside the configured shared page wrapper.

publicSignatures.name: BookingPageWrapperLayout
publicSignatures.signature: export default async function BookingPageWrapperLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode })

edgeCases.behavior: The nullish header result is converted to undefined before being passed to the wrapper.
The header value is passed unchanged as the wrapper nonce.
The children are rendered unchanged inside the shared wrapper.

invariants.description: Rendered content is always nested within the shared page wrapper.
The wrapper is always configured as a booking page.
License requirements are always disabled for this layout.
A missing request nonce is passed onward as undefined.

assumptions.description: The layout is invoked within a Next.js request context where headers() is available.
The shared wrapper accepts booking-page, license, nonce, and child-content properties with the shown meanings.

concurrencyModel.notes: The function awaits request header access and maintains no module or request mutation state.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking page request includes an x-nonce header.
given: headers() returns an object where h.get("x-nonce") returns "nonce-value"
moduleContractTests.then: PageWrapper receives isBookingPage={true}, requiresLicense={false}, nonce="nonce-value", and renders children
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the security nonce propagation and fixed booking-page wrapper configuration.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking page request does not include an x-nonce header.
given: headers() returns an object where h.get("x-nonce") returns null
moduleContractTests.then: PageWrapper receives nonce={undefined}, isBookingPage={true}, requiresLicense={false}, and renders children
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the null-to-undefined normalization used by the wrapper contract.
